issues.description: Method Stock.findStockIngredient has inconsistent parameter lists across artifacts. The problem statement UML and the provided solution declare a single-parameter method: findStockIngredient(String name) -> StockIngredient. In the template repository, Stock.findStockIngredient is declared with two parameters: findStockIngredient(String name, boolean caseSensitive) (template/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Stock.java). Furthermore, other methods in the template (add and take) call findStockIngredient(...) with a single String argument, which does not match the template's two-parameter signature and will cause compilation errors for students. This mismatch (template vs. problem statement/solution) will block students from using the API described in the exercise and from compiling the template code as-is.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the template API match the problem statement and solution by providing a single-argument method public StockIngredient findStockIngredient(String name). Options: (1) Replace the two-parameter signature in the template with public StockIngredient findStockIngredient(String name) and implement the chosen case-sensitivity behavior there; or (2) keep the existing two-parameter method but add an overloaded convenience method public StockIngredient findStockIngredient(String name) that delegates to findStockIngredient(name, true/false) with the chosen default. Also update internal calls in the template (add/take) if necessary so they call the single-argument method and compile.
